Builds immutable page metadata using the engine's injected clock.
PageSnapshot
Immutable backend-neutral batch snapshot transformed by the observation engine.
PageStabilityWaiter
Waits for a navigated page's DOM to stop changing, using IPage.waitForCondition(String, Duration) - a single, backend-natively-bounded call - rather than a Java-side polling loop that repeatedly calls IPage.evaluate(String).
PlaywrightBrowserProvider
Playwright service provider discovered by the core facade through ServiceLoader.
PlaywrightCoverageGate
Enforces a real aggregate line-coverage threshold for the Playwright adapter package ( io.webagent4j.browser.playwright), computed from the merged JaCoCo report produced by this module's report-aggregate execution.
PluginDescriptor
Small immutable description of a plugin using non-sensitive metadata.
PluginId
Stable, non-sensitive textual identity for a plugin.
PluginLoader
Explicit deterministic loader for trusted locator strategy providers.
PluginLoadException
Fail-closed result of an explicit plugin discovery attempt.
PluginLoadFailure
Safe structured diagnostic for plugin loading.
PluginLoadFailureType
Stable categories for fail-closed plugin discovery failures.
PluginRegistry
Immutable, thread-safe result of one explicit plugin load.
PluginVersion
Validated, non-sensitive plugin version metadata with no resolution semantics.
PolicyDecision
An immutable, terminal policy decision: an PolicyOutcome paired with the PolicyReason it was reached for.
PolicyOutcome
The result of one policy evaluation.
PolicyReason
A stable, machine-comparable identifier for why a PolicyDecision was reached.
PortableKey
Backend-neutral keyboard keys supported by the action engine.
QueryParameterPolicy
Deterministic policy for which URL query parameters survive normalization.
QueryParameterPolicy.QueryParameterMode
The base rule QueryParameterPolicy applies before per-parameter overrides.
RawLink
One link discovered in a rendered DOM, before normalization/scope/dedup decisions - the browser equivalent of ExtractedLink in webagent4j-crawler (jsoup-parsed static HTML).
RecordedAction
Recorded projection of one action-backed step's outcome.
RecordedCondition
Safe, recorded outcome of one step's guard condition.
RecordedFailure
Safe, recorded failure reason, used both for the overall WorkflowRecording.failure() and for a per-step RecordedWorkflowStep.failure().
RecordedWorkflowStep
Safe, recorded outcome of one workflow step.
RecordingFormatException
Thrown when a serialized recording cannot be decoded: malformed JSON, a duplicate or unknown field, an unsupported schema version, an invalid enum value, a malformed Instant, a value of the wrong JSON type, a violated recording invariant, or trailing content after the document.
RecordingId
Stable, caller-supplied identifier for one WorkflowRecording.
RecordingSchemaVersion
Numeric schema version of the canonical JSON recording format produced and consumed by JsonWorkflowRecordingCodec.
RedirectHop
One HTTP redirect hop observed while resolving a single fetch attempt.
ResponseTooLargeException
A response body exceeded its request's maxResponseBytes while being read.
RetryPolicy
Immutable retry configuration shared by operations that may fail transiently.
ScopeEvaluator
Scope decisions for a browser crawl, reusing CrawlDecision/CrawlDecisionType from webagent4j-crawler-api unchanged - a decision is a decision regardless of backend.
Secret
Immutable sensitive value whose textual representation is always redacted.
SecureObservationRedactionPolicy
Small deterministic default redaction policy for passwords, common secrets/tokens, and reliable credit-card control hints.
Selection
Immutable select-option request using exactly one portable selection mode.
SelectionType
Portable select-option modes.
SemanticElement
Immutable lightweight description of one meaningful page element.
SemanticElementId
Immutable semantic identity used for deduplication and relationships within an observation.
SemanticLocatorDefinitionFactory
Default factory that reuses immutable Phase 2 locator definitions.
SemanticObservationFilter
Default visibility, decoration, and semantic-relevance filter.
SemanticRelationship
Immutable relationship between two elements in the same observation.
SemanticRelationshipType
Important semantic relationship type; this is intentionally not a DOM edge model.
SemanticTree
Immutable forest of top-level semantic page regions in document order.
SemanticTreeBuilder
Builds a bounded semantic hierarchy from meaningful parent relationships.
SemanticTreeBuilder.TreeResult
 
SemanticTreeNode
Immutable lightweight semantic-tree node; it is intentionally not a DOM node copy.
SnapshotElement
Simple backend-neutral batch-capture DTO.
SnapshotElementState
Backend-neutral immutable state DTO used only at the observation SPI boundary.
StabilizationResult
Immutable stabilization outcome.
TableObservation
Immutable bounded semantic table summary.
TableObserver
Builds bounded table summaries and explicit truncation records.
TableObserver.TableResult
 
TabListObservation
Immutable tab-list summary with selected tab and associated panels when available.
TextMatch
Immutable text matching criterion.
TextMatcher
Deterministic exact, structural and conservative fuzzy text matcher.
TextMatchType
Deterministic text comparison modes supported by locator definitions.
Timeouts
Immutable timeout categories used to avoid ambiguous global timeouts.
TraversalStrategy
Order in which the frontier releases discovered URLs for fetching.
UrlContainsVerification
Verifies that the current page URL contains an expected fragment.
ValueDisposition
Describes why an observed form value is or is not retained.
VerificationEngine
Evaluates ordered deterministic conditions through one centralized poller.
VerificationInterruptedException
Signals that deterministic verification polling respected thread interruption.
VerificationPoller
Central polling loop used by action preconditions and postconditions.
VerificationResult
Immutable result of one deterministic verification.
Verifications
Readable factories for built-in deterministic verifications.
VerificationType
Stable deterministic verification categories.
VerifiedActionExample
Demonstrates polling multiple postconditions and capturing semantic state.
VerifiedNavigationExample
Executable example covering the first complete semantic browser vertical.
VerifiedNetworkAddresses
The exact IP addresses a transport is authorized to connect to for one destination, in resolution order, alongside the logical hostname it must still present for the Host header, TLS SNI, and certificate hostname verification - the physical address is never a substitute for the logical hostname in any of those three places.
Verifier
Stateless default verifier.
ViewportSize
Immutable viewport dimensions in CSS pixels.
WaitBudget
A monotonic deadline, optionally shared across several sequential sub-operations.
WaitEngine
The one deterministic polling coordinator shared by every domain that needs to wait for a condition: locator resolution, verification, and action stabilization/postconditions.
WaitInterruptedException
Signals that a wait was stopped because the current thread was interrupted, either before or during a sleep between polls.
WaitPolicy
Immutable polling cadence: how often to probe and, optionally, how long a satisfied result must remain continuously satisfied before it is accepted.
WaitResult<T>
Outcome of one WaitEngine.await(WaitBudget, WaitPolicy, IWaitProbe) call.
WaitSample<T>
One side-effect-free reading taken by an IWaitProbe.
WaitSample.Status
Whether a sample currently satisfies the awaited condition.
WaitStatus
Terminal outcome of a WaitEngine.await(WaitBudget, WaitPolicy, IWaitProbe) call.
WebAgent
Lightweight public facade for creating WebAgent4J components.
WebAgent4jCli
Command-line entry point built exclusively on WebAgent4J's public API.
WebAgentException
Base unchecked exception for failures that prevent WebAgent4J from honoring an API contract.
Workflow
Immutable, reusable, ordered sequence of IWorkflowSteps over a declared set of typed inputs.
Workflow.Builder
Mutable builder for Workflow.
WorkflowActionSummary
Restricted projection of an ActionResult for one action-backed workflow step.
WorkflowConditionResult
Safe, structured outcome of evaluating one step's IWorkflowCondition, explaining why a step was executed or WorkflowStepStatus.SKIPPED.
WorkflowConditions
Factory for the small, fixed set of declarative IWorkflowConditions Phase 0.8 supports.
WorkflowEngine
Deterministic, single-lane executor for Workflow definitions.
WorkflowFailedException
Optional exception-style projection of a structured, failed WorkflowResult.
WorkflowFailure
Safe, structured overall failure reason for a WorkflowStatus.FAILED WorkflowResult.
WorkflowFailureType
Stable categories for a workflow-level failure.
WorkflowId
Stable, human-readable identifier for one Workflow definition.
WorkflowInputs
Immutable, explicit set of input values supplied to one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
WorkflowInputs.Builder
Mutable builder for WorkflowInputs.
WorkflowLoginExample
Demonstrates a deterministic, sequential webagent4j-workflow definition: typed public and secret variables, required inputs, a conditionally skipped step, real action-pipeline integration, and a structured, secret-masked result.
WorkflowOutputs
Immutable set of variables produced by a workflow execution's steps, exposed through WorkflowResult.output(WorkflowVariable).
WorkflowRecorder
Captures a WorkflowResult into an immutable WorkflowRecording.
WorkflowRecording
An immutable, versioned recording that excludes raw workflow values and preserves engine-redacted diagnostics.
WorkflowRecordingExample
Demonstrates webagent4j-recording: capture one workflow execution into a versioned, secret-safe WorkflowRecording, round-trip it through canonical JSON, then verify a second independent execution against the decoded recording with WorkflowReplayVerifier.
WorkflowReplayMismatch
One structured difference found by WorkflowReplayVerifier between a recorded execution and a new actual execution.
WorkflowReplayMismatchType
Stable category of one difference found by WorkflowReplayVerifier.
WorkflowReplayResult
Outcome of comparing a WorkflowRecording against a new WorkflowResult.
WorkflowReplayVerifier
Deterministically compares a WorkflowRecording against a new, independently produced WorkflowResult.
WorkflowResult
Immutable, structured outcome of one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
WorkflowStatus
Overall terminal outcome of one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.
WorkflowStepId
Stable, human-readable identifier for one step within a Workflow.
WorkflowStepResult
Immutable, safe, structured outcome of one IWorkflowStep within a WorkflowResult.
WorkflowSteps
Factory for the two built-in IWorkflowStep kinds Phase 0.8 supports.
WorkflowStepStatus
Terminal outcome of one IWorkflowStep within a workflow execution.
WorkflowStepType
Broad category of one IWorkflowStep, for safe diagnostics.
WorkflowVariable<T>
Typed key identifying one workflow variable by name, runtime type, and sensitivity.
WorkflowVariableMissingException
Thrown by IWorkflowVariables.require(WorkflowVariable) when the requested variable has no value at the point of the call.
